_what: Thirty-two create stages at contract 170.0.0 (2026-11-12 09:02 - 09:11Z, build cb114145) to measure the exit plans 170 put on the trade level menu (per direction `targets` -> `exitPlans`: 1 - 8 plans of 1 - 4 legs {method, closePct}), which neither the tool description nor the schema explains. Each changes only the menu of the trend-continuation plan (the 168 record's base plan); the menu's stops are ATR 1 / 1.5 / 2, the same on both directions. Every staged draft was read back (get_strategy_draft: kept as sent every time) and discarded; none was committed, and get_strategy_draft read `draft: null` after every discard. GET /mcp/version read 170.0.0 / cb114145 before the first stage and after the last.
